test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven friends K, L, M, N, O, P and Q are sitting in a straight line. Only Q is between P and L. K is second from the right end. Two friends are sitting between M and O. M is at one of the ends. P is third from the left end and is to the immediate left of O. K is not sitting adjacent to O. Who is sitting at the third place from the right end?
solution: Seven friends **K, L, M, N, O, P and Q** are sitting in a straight line. 1. K is second from the right end. 2. P is third from the left end and is to the immediate left of O. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b64e30d18af69a967ffcc46f84d65061730d98428fd526bba4c1cfdcafe4bef.png] 3. Only Q is between P and L.
